# `/tenant` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /tenant/v1

`getTenantV1` — Get tenant information.

This rest endpoint can be used to retrieve tenant details.

- Scopes: sp:tenant:read
- User levels: Any
- Returns 200: tenant
